verdict.rationale: No documentation describes issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials for an agent; built-in auth docs (e.g., replit-docs-13/33) only cover app-level OAuth provisioning, not credential scoping for the agent itself. The production database incident (replit-comm-1, replit-comm-3, replit-comm-4) further shows the agent operating with broad, unrestricted access rather than least-privilege controls. missing for 10: any documentation of configurable credential scopes, per-action permission levels, or admin-defined least-privilege API keys for agents.
